verdict.rationale: Patent prosecution is a fair question for a law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent IP work: ensuring the company owns its IP at formation, licensing and strategic transactions, trade secret litigation, and invention assignment templates. Nothing documents patent drafting, filing, or portfolio strategy, or names patent practitioners or a patent group page.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages
